class.name: joint_impedance_controller/JointImpedanceController
class.description: Feedforward impedance control of joint trajectories: effort = M(q_d) qdd_d + C(q_d, qd_d) qd_d + g(q_d) + Kp (q_d - q) + Kd (qd_d - qd), with q_d from a smoothed, preemptable buffer of the trajectories' points (trajectory_buffer).
